title: A first review record on a PR needs a head sha on every Round line.
ruling: Coordinator pick Q1 a, 17:35 CST Nov 8: a first record needs shas on its Round lines. Not the owner's words. The incident was PR 2235, which posted rounds 1 to 3 at once, read on another PR's heads.
